notes: Do not treat templates as authoritative state.
If initializing a new run, COPY templates to your runtime state folder and then edit the copies.
This scenario is a convergent Rome-like settlement (Nova Roma) with no historical or political connection to actual Rome.

changes.desc: Added canonical 50-domain technology registry, governance rules, prerequisites, and seeded baseline tiers for 500‑person Nova Roma.
Added domain metadata (category/tags/era), full prerequisite graph, era gating rules, and MSR tech-delta snapshot policy.
Corrected canon starting_population and premise to ~500-person isolated settlement; removed stale 2000-person defaults.
Restored NR_SPEC.json hard-spec and reattached proof-of-load/self-check protocol hooks after v1.1.1 regen dropped the file.
Added an optional 'ADVISOR' section to the MSR report contract, positioned after 'METRICS' and before 'SUMMARY'.
Updated news entry format in the MSR contract: Headline → follow-up line → metric in parentheses at end of follow-up, with no labels.
Specified that codes (milestone IDs, initiative codes, UGRID cells, bank tags) must be rendered in fixed-width font.
Allowed the engine to auto-estimate annualized values, GDP splits, and time-to-relief using defined formulas instead of manual inputs.
Moved the auto-estimation rule from the MSR contract to the global playability file (novaroma_playability.json) so it applies to all outputs.
Updated all version fields in 2.0 JSON files to '2.0.0'.
Reverted the version fields under the 'changes' array in manifest.json to their previous values, keeping only the top-level version as '2.0.0'.
